pulls.author: jonsfy

pulls.author: jonsfy
pulls.body_excerpt: This pull request simplifies the DES S-box table representation in `DESCrypt`. The eight separate S-box tables, `s0p` through `s7p`, are consolidated into a single contiguous table. Each S-box is identified by a fixed offset within the shared table, and the DES round function is updated to use the corresponding offset when accessing the S-box entries. This reduces the number of separate table objects and provides a simpler and more uniform table layout while preserving the existing DES transformation logic and lookup results. pulls.title: 8364407: [REDO] Consolidate Identity of self-inverse operations
pulls.author: SirYwell
pulls.body_excerpt: The previous approach was flawed for `short` and `char` as these are int-subtypes and truncate the result (see the backout issue https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8364409 for a reproducer). This change now first ensures that the input type is small enough so no truncation gets lost when dropping the operations. The previous implementation also used an `InvolutionNode` superclass with one `Identity(...)` implementation, but there were some reservations whether this is the right way to go. As we now have a `ReverseBytesNode`, there is also less benefit in having the supertype, as this covers 4

pulls.title: 8351351: Pre-hash mode, context string, etc for ML-DSA
pulls.author: wangweij
pulls.body_excerpt: Add a new `SignatureParameterSpec` internal API to fully utilize the capabilities of ML-DSA. The updated ACVP test demonstrates its usage. The new API is internal because it's not yet clear how to provide this feature to users. A key should not be shared between plain ML-DSA and HashML-DSA, but context can.
